intro: Over 76 articles published between April 12 and May 4, 2026, cover supply-chain threats. Key actors observed include Lazarus Group, CanisterSprawl, and GRU. Critical vulnerabilities such as CVE-2026-1731 (CVSS 9.8), CVE-2026-39987 (CVSS 9.3), CVE-2026-40176, and CVE-2026-40177 were highlighted. The reporting spans technology, software development, cryptocurrency, logistics, and manufacturing sectors, with global impact across North America, Europe, Asia, and the Arctic. The severity mix comprises 13 critical, 45 high, 13 medium, and 4 informational articles.
